shortDescription: Australia's Star Entertainment ASX:SGR posted a smaller annual loss on Monday, helped by aggressive cost cuts under its broader restructuring programme.The embattled casino operator reported a statutory net loss after tax of A$307.3 million ($220.03 million) for the fiscal year ended June 30, compa…

children: posted a smaller annual loss on Monday, helped by aggressive cost cuts under its broader restructuring programme.

The embattled casino operator reported a statutory net loss after tax of A$307.3 million ($220.03 million) for the fiscal year ended June 30, compared with a loss of A$427.9 million reported a year earlier.
